hard_numeric_fact_text: FACT: 10 Oct 2026 NSE filing: Rs466.74 cr turnkey order from MGVCL (Robust-III, 18/16 months), ~88% of FY26 revenue of Rs531 cr (web-reported). thesis: Small Gujarat discom-EPC with a Rs467 cr MGVCL award (~88% of FY26 revenue) and a new 1,000 MVA transformer plant, trading ~12x EV/EBITDA after a 51% price fall. But the award was already disclosed at L1 stage, the plant has no commercial production yet, FY26 CFO/PAT is -0.08 with 267 receivable days and receivables +213% vs revenue +143%, interest cover 3.0, and the stock trades Rs4 cr/day. Cash conversion, not orders, is the binding link.
